part2_rest_adverse_selection.note: adverse_cents = fill entry - the leg's eventual pre-bell seller-hit low; >0 means the rest was hit ABOVE where the leg later traded (adverse selection).

state_at_fill_maker.note: RISING at fill = rest caught a seller dumping into strength (non-adverse; price rose after). FALLING at fill (23) = rest swept mid-decline (adverse; the 56c tail lives here).
